cards.ex: I'm still trying to get a handle on all the new communication software.
cards.exUz: Men hali yangi aloqa dasturlarini o'zlashtirishga harakat qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir haqida asosiy tushunchaga ega bo'lish, uni o'zlashtirish.

cards.ex: He could always spin a good yarn about his adventures.
cards.exUz: U har doim o'zining sarguzashtlari haqida yaxshi hikoya aytib berardi.
cards.uzDef: Qiziqarli, ko'pincha hayoliy hikoya aytish.

cards.ex: The meeting was a chance for employees to air their grievances.
cards.exUz: Ushbu yig'ilish xodimlar uchun o'z shikoyatlarini bildirish imkoniyati edi.
cards.uzDef: Shikoyat yoki noroziliklarni ochiqchasiga bildirish.

cards.ex: The presentation, to put it mildly, was a disaster.
cards.exUz: Taqdimot, yumshoq aytganda, falokat edi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni kamaytirib ko'rsatish, yumshoqroq ifodalash.

cards.ex: He was really laying it on thick to try and impress her.
cards.exUz: U unga ta'sir o'tkazish uchun juda mubolag'a qilayotgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Haddan tashqari maqtov yoki yolg'on ishlatish.

cards.ex: The company's environmental policy is a key talking point in their marketing.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning atrof-muhit siyosati ularning marketingida asosiy muhokama nuqtasidir.
cards.uzDef: Muhokama qilinadigan asosiy mavzu yoki argument.

cards.ex: Her instructions were as clear as a bell.
cards.exUz: Uning ko'rsatmalari juda aniq edi.
cards.uzDef: Ovoz yoki ma'lumot juda aniq va tushunarli.

cards.ex: Word gets around quickly in this office, so be careful what you say.
cards.exUz: Bu ofisda gap tez tarqaladi, shuning uchun nima deyayotganingizga ehtiyot bo'ling.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumot tezda tarqaladi, odamlar bilib qoladi.

cards.ex: She has a knack for explaining complex ideas simply.
cards.exUz: U murakkab g'oyalarni oddiy tushuntirish qobiliyatiga ega.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilishda tabiiy qobiliyatga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: His name is on the tip of my tongue, I just can't remember it!
cards.exUz: Uning ismi tilim uchida, lekin eslay olmayapman!
cards.uzDef: Bir so'zni eslashga yaqin bo'lish, ammo uni eslay olmaslik.

cards.ex: It's getting late, let's call it a day.
cards.exUz: Kech bo'lyapti, keling, bugungi ishni tugatamiz.
cards.uzDef: Ishni yoki faoliyatni shu bilan tugatishga qaror qilish.

cards.ex: Let's get the ball rolling on this project.
cards.exUz: Keling, ushbu loyihani ishga tushiramiz.
cards.uzDef: Nimadirni boshlash, jarayonni ishga tushirish.

cards.ex: That documentary gave me a lot of food for thought.
cards.exUz: Ushbu hujjatli film menga o'ylash uchun ko'p sabab berdi.
cards.uzDef: O'ylashni talab qiladigan narsa, fikrlovchi narsa.

cards.ex: He's a smooth talking salesman, but I don't trust him.
cards.exUz: U shirinso'z sotuvchi, lekin men unga ishonmayman.
cards.uzDef: Ishontirish qobiliyatiga ega, ammo ishonchsiz gapiradigan odam.

cards.ex: We seem to be working at cross purposes; I thought we agreed on something else.
cards.exUz: Biz bir-birimizga qarama-qarshi maqsadlar bilan harakat qilayotganga o'xshaymiz; menimcha, biz boshqa narsaga kelishib olgandik.
cards.uzDef: Bir-biriga qarama-qarshi bo'lgan maqsadlar bilan harakat qilish.

cards.ex: They were just talking around in circles and not making any decisions.
cards.exUz: Ular shunchaki aylanib gapirishdi va hech qanday qaror qabul qilishmadi.
cards.uzDef: Bir mavzuda natijasiz aylanib gapirish, hech narsaga erishmaslik.

cards.ex: In a nutshell, the project failed because of poor planning.
cards.exUz: Qisqasi, loyiha yomon rejalashtirish tufayli muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Qisqa va aniq tarzda, ixcham qilib tushuntirish.

cards.ex: I always get tongue-tied when I have to speak in public.
cards.exUz: Men har doim omma oldida gapirishga to'g'ri kelganda, tilim bog'lanib qoladi.
cards.uzDef: Hayajondan yoki uyalishdan gapira olmaslik.

cards.ex: The debate turned into a war of words between the two candidates.
cards.exUz: Munozara ikki nomzod o'rtasida og'zaki jangga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Jiddiy bahs yoki tortishuv, og'zaki hujumlar.

cards.ex: Her silence spoke volumes about how she felt.
cards.exUz: Uning sukuti uning qanday his qilayotganini juda ko'p narsani anglatardi.
cards.uzDef: So'zlarga qaraganda ko'proq narsani ifodalash, juda muhim bo'lish.

cards.ex: We should definitely keep in touch after the conference.
cards.exUz: Anjumandan keyin albatta aloqada bo'lishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy aloqani saqlab turish, xabar almashib turish.

cards.ex: He's a bit out of touch with modern technology.
cards.exUz: U zamonaviy texnologiyalardan biroz orqada qolgan.
cards.uzDef: Hozirgi voqealardan xabardor bo'lmaslik, zamondan orqada qolish.

cards.ex: To be frank, I didn't enjoy the presentation at all.
cards.exUz: Ochig'ini aytsam, menga taqdimot umuman yoqmadi.
cards.uzDef: Ochiqchasiga va to'g'ri gapirish, samimiy bo'lish.

cards.ex: I can explain the plan in broad strokes, but we'll need to discuss the details later.
cards.exUz: Men rejani umumiy jihatdan tushuntira olaman, lekin keyin tafsilotlarni muhokama qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Umumiy tarzda, batafsil bo'lmagan holda.

cards.ex: Communication is a two-way street; you have to listen as well as talk.
cards.exUz: Aloqa ikki tomonlama bo'lishi kerak; siz gapirish bilan birga tinglashingiz ham kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'zaro bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan narsa, bir tomonlama bo'lmasligi kerak.

cards.ex: Before making a decision, the judge asked him to state his case.
cards.exUz: Sudya qaror qabul qilishdan oldin undan o'z argumentini aytishni so'radi.
cards.uzDef: O'z nuqtai nazaringizni yoki argumentingizni aniq va ishonarli tarzda ifodalash.

cards.ex: You could hear a pin drop in the room as she began to speak.
cards.exUz: U gapira boshlaganida xonada jimjitlik hukm surardi.
cards.uzDef: Juda jim bo'lish, hech qanday shovqin yo'qligi.

cards.ex: She voiced her opinion on the matter, even though it was unpopular.
cards.exUz: U bu masala bo'yicha o'z fikrini bildirdi, garchi bu mashhur bo'lmasa ham.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikrini yoki nuqtai nazarini bildirish.

cards.ex: We're on the same wavelength, so we usually agree on most things.
cards.exUz: Biz bir to'lqinda bo'lganimiz uchun, odatda ko'p narsada kelishamiz.
cards.uzDef: O'xshash fikrlarga ega bo'lish, bir-birini oson tushunish.

cards.ex: He repeated the message word for word.
cards.exUz: U xabarni so'zma-so'z takrorladi.
cards.uzDef: Har bir so'zni aynan takrorlash, o'zgartirmasdan.
